name: The Grove
summary: High-end shopping mall features trendy retailers, restaurants & a theater amid a bustling promenade.
description: Los Angeles' favorite shopping, dining and lifestyle destination featuring a curated mix of retail, restaurants and entertainment in an open-air environment pulsing with style and energy. Experience iconic shopping under the California sun with signature amenities including a historic double-decker trolley, AMC movie theater, valet parking, and premier concierge services.
demographics: The Grove attracts an affluent, cosmopolitan demographic with visitors primarily in the 25-54 age range, including young professionals, families, and tourists seeking an upscale shopping experience. The trade area encompasses affluent Los Angeles neighborhoods including West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, and the Miracle Mile district, with household incomes significantly above the metropolitan average. Shoppers demonstrate strong preferences for experiential retail combining shopping with dining and entertainment, favoring premium brands and lifestyle-oriented experiences in the open-air format that has made The Grove an iconic Los Angeles destination since its opening.
